title: Concept: Tomcat Catalina version disclosed in a response
description: A Tomcat Catalina version string in a body in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The container release has its own advisory list, and the default error page also confirms the manager and host-manager paths exist.
applicability: Deployments that render a Tomcat Catalina version string in a body into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The container release has its own advisory list, and the default error page also confirms the manager and host-manager paths exist.
